name: subcontractor-accounting-skills
description: Australian construction and mining subcontractor workflows: progress claims, retentions, WIP and over/under-billing, contract cost tracking, fuel tax credits, Coal LSL, payroll tax contractor provisions, contractor super and TPAR. Prep-only. Not lodgment. Not tax advice.

safety.noLodgmentBoundary: Never lodge, file, submit, transmit, declare, pay, or finalise any tax return, BAS, TPAR, payroll tax return, fuel tax credit claim, Coal LSL return, or other material with the ATO, a state revenue office, or any other government agency.

interface.shortDescription: Progress claims, retentions, WIP, fuel tax credits and contractor payroll tax
interface.longDescription: Ten workflow skills for Australian construction and mining subcontractor accounting. Each skill encodes the process and the tie-outs, and sends the agent to the primary source for the rates, thresholds and statutory timeframes that change. Outputs are review-ready workpapers. An authorised human reviews, decides and lodges. Not tax advice. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Australian Taxation Office, any state revenue office, or Coal LSL.
defaultPrompt: Prepare progress claim 7 for this contract from the cost ledger and the schedule of rates. Show the retention held to date against the contract cap and list anything that does not tie.
